newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 CLOSES DOWN, HIGH CAPS STEADY.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 CLOSES DOWN, HIGH CAPS STEADY.

text.p: Czech major issues staged a small comeback on Friday but losses in the broader market pulled the PX50 index to a new 1997 low of 503.2.

After sustained declines over several weeks, SPT Telecom and power utility CEZ posted modest gains. Support for CEZ, which has been seen as particularly vulnerable at around the 900 crown mark was said to be especially strong. On Friday CEZ rose 10 crowns to 920.
"The market is probably finding out that at 900 there is very strong resistance for CEZ," said Lubomir Vystavel of ING Barings.

Despite gains to the two most heavily weighted shares, the third, Komercni Banka lost 11 crowns to 1,944. Vystavel said the potential knock-on effect of the current economic slowdown in the Czech Republic on Komercni's bottom line was probably causing bearish sentiment about the share.
